body:
**Severity:** medium. Fix in 0.2.8 (high/medium).

**Who is affected and why it matters:** C++ code declaring `std::vector<int> compute(3);` while a function `compute` exists: a false call edge.

**Reproduce:**
```cpp
int compute(int);
void f(){ std::vector<int> compute(3); }
```

**Actual:** edge `f → compute`.

**Expected:** no edge.

**Where to start:** `devkb/cpp_symbols.py:791-797` (only an alphanumeric previous character is treated as a type).

**Done when:** a fixture test fails on `main` and passes.

Found by the 0.2.5 → 0.2.8 quality audit (main at `4369145`); reproduced twice, by the reviewer and independently.
title: C++ declarations with template or pointer types are not read as calls
